run_multi_turn_question: run a multi-turn question SGL function with two questions and stream the assistant responses
create_openai_backend: create an SGL OpenAI backend connected to OpenRouter API for the google/gemma-7b-it:free model
set_default_backend: set the SGL default backend to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint via sgl.set_default_backend
run_single_request: run a single multi-turn question request and print each message role with its content
run_batch_requests: run a batch of multi-turn question requests and collect all message histories
